title: Exchange symmetry of correlated Gaussian measure
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. The joint law of a standard Gaussian vector and its coordinatewise $\rho$-correlated Gaussian partner is invariant under exchanging the two vectors.
